title: Product
description: Read-only retained product evidence from Postgres. Tables are current snapshots, independent of the Grafana time picker; each title states its window. No provider calls or content jobs. Use app Status for configured caps, reserve amounts and live budget availability.

panels.title: Provider spend and outstanding holds (UTC)
panels.description: Settled spend is attributed to call creation in UTC. Holds include all pending/uncertain calls, including earlier days. Caps and live available funds are in app Status; holds are not additional settled spend.

targets.rawSql: WITH calls AS (SELECT 'Anthropic' AS provider, created_at, status, cost_micros, reserved_micros FROM llm_calls UNION ALL SELECT 'X discovery', created_at, status, cost_micros, reserved_micros FROM x_discovery_calls) SELECT provider AS "Provider", coalesce(sum(cost_micros) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'),0)/1000000.0 AS "Today ($)", coalesce(sum(cost_micros) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'),0)/1000000.0 AS "Month ($)", coalesce(sum(reserved_micros) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('pending','uncertain')),0)/1000000.0 AS "Holds ($)" FROM calls GROUP BY provider ORDER BY "Provider"

panels.title: Latest edition editorial modes
panels.description: Latest retained immutable edition, including manual editions. AI mode may reuse cached work; it does not prove a fresh paid call. Worker timing is in Jobs and app Status.

targets.rawSql: SELECT d.created_at AS "Created (UTC)", t->>'name' AS "Topic", t->'editorial'->>'mode' AS "Stories", t->'postEditorial'->>'mode' AS "Posts" FROM (SELECT created_at, snapshot FROM digest_previews ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) d CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d.snapshot->'topics') t

panels.title: Source freshness and current errors
panels.description: Current source snapshots; no error messages or source URLs are returned. A successful empty response may contain no new items.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name AS "Source", last_success AS "Last success (UTC)", last_item_count AS "Items", CASE WHEN last_error IS NULL THEN 'no current error' ELSE 'error (see Status)' END AS "State" FROM content_sources ORDER BY last_success ASC NULLS FIRST, name LIMIT 100

panels.title: Distinct articles per topic (rolling 24 hours)
panels.description: Publication timestamps, deduplicated within each topic. Includes disabled topics and sources; this is retained ingestion coverage, not edition picks.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.name AS topic, count(DISTINCT i.id)::int AS articles FROM topics t LEFT JOIN content_sources s ON s.topic_id=t.id LEFT JOIN content_observations o ON o.source_id=s.id LEFT JOIN content_items i ON i.id=o.item_id AND i.published_at >= now()-interval '24 hours' AND i.published_at <= now() GROUP BY t.id,t.name ORDER BY t.name

panels.title: X citation verification (rolling 24 hours)
panels.description: Distinct cited IDs per topic from direct X discovery. Verification means a retained official embed exists now; not incremental yield or engagement. Empty means no citations in this window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(t.name,'deleted/unknown') AS topic, count(DISTINCT c.external_id)::int AS cited_posts, count(DISTINCT c.external_id) FILTER (WHERE p.external_id IS NOT NULL)::int AS verified_posts FROM x_search_citations c LEFT JOIN topics t ON t.id=c.topic_id LEFT JOIN social_posts p ON p.platform='x' AND p.external_id=c.external_id WHERE c.discovered_at >= now()-interval '24 hours' GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY topic

panels.title: Scheduled reserve lifecycle (latest seven days)
panels.description: Durable lifecycle only. Protected reserve amount, cap and current availability are read from configuration by app Status, not inferred here. Pending is not a missed run before its scheduled time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT budget_day::text AS "Day (UTC)", scheduled_at AS "Scheduled (UTC)", state AS "State", attempt AS "Attempt" FROM scheduled_ai_budget_days ORDER BY budget_day DESC LIMIT 7

panels.title: Source article coverage (rolling 24 hours)
panels.description: Distinct articles published in the last 24 hours and attributed to each source, including sources with zero. Multiple sources may cite the same article; these counts must not be summed as unique topic coverage. Last response count includes older and duplicate items and is not new-item yield.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.name AS "Source", count(DISTINCT i.id)::int AS "Articles (24h)", s.last_item_count AS "Last response items", s.last_success AS "Last success (UTC)", (s.last_error IS NOT NULL) AS "Current error" FROM content_sources s LEFT JOIN content_observations o ON o.source_id=s.id LEFT JOIN content_items i ON i.id=o.item_id AND i.published_at >= now()-interval '24 hours' AND i.published_at <= now() GROUP BY s.id,s.name,s.last_item_count,s.last_success,s.last_error ORDER BY "Articles (24h)","Source"

panels.title: Recent retained editions (latest seven)
panels.description: Immutable edition snapshots, including manual editions and older revisions. Created time is publication storage time, not worker duration. AI topic counts describe recorded editorial modes, which may reuse cache; no live latency or fresh-provider claim.

targets.rawSql: SELECT d.created_at AS "Created (UTC)", totals.* FROM (SELECT created_at,snapshot FROM digest_previews ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 7) d CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*)::int AS "Topics", sum(jsonb_array_length(coalesce(t->'stories','[]'::jsonb)))::int AS "Stories", sum(jsonb_array_length(coalesce(t->'posts','[]'::jsonb)))::int AS "Posts", count(*) FILTER (WHERE t->'editorial'->>'mode'='ai')::int AS "AI story topics", count(*) FILTER (WHERE t->'postEditorial'->>'mode'='ai')::int AS "AI post topics" FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.snapshot->'topics') t) totals ORDER BY d.created_at DESC

panels.title: AI ledger by edition (latest seven)
panels.description: Anthropic ledger matched by edition UUID, never timestamp overlap. Settled charges include failed calls with recorded cost; holds are pending/uncertain reservations. Zero calls may mean cached or fallback work. Excludes X discovery and unpublished attempts/retries; not total scheduled-run spend. Created time is not worker duration.

targets.rawSql: SELECT d.created_at AS "Created (UTC)", left(d.id::text,8) AS "Edition", count(c.run_id)::int AS "Calls", count(c.run_id) FILTER (WHERE c.status IN ('pending','uncertain'))::int AS "Unresolved", coalesce(sum(c.cost_micros),0)/1000000.0 AS "Charged ($)", coalesce(sum(c.reserved_micros) FILTER (WHERE c.status IN ('pending','uncertain')),0)/1000000.0 AS "Holds ($)" FROM (SELECT id,created_at FROM digest_previews ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 7) d LEFT JOIN llm_calls c ON c.run_id=d.id::text GROUP BY d.id,d.created_at ORDER BY d.created_at DESC,d.id DESC
